sections.text_helper: Section 30.4.10 "Arithmetic subtraction" in chapter 30 (Public key accelerator (PKA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 934.
sections.section_content:
The arithmetic subtraction operation calculates:
• A-B, when A≥B
• A+2int(M/32)×32+1-B, when A<B and the residue of M/32 is greater than zero
• A+2int(M/32)×32-B, when A<B and the residue of M/32 is zero
For the last two list items, the 32-bit word following the most significant word of the output is
0xFFFF FFFF, as the result is negative.
The following table summarizes the operation instructions.
